name: calcurse-8b44a54f-blind17
instr:
# calcurse: repairing a calendar manager without a test suite

The repository has received 17 separate undocumented edits.

A program that keeps track of what someone has coming up and of the things they mean to get done now gets much of that wrong. Nothing about the saved files changed and nothing about what was typed in changed, yet entries that used to come back exactly as they were entered now come back altered, misplaced or not at all, and several commands stop partway or crash.

Starting up and asking for the things to be done returns nothing at all, and the filters that pick out such items come back empty even though those items were written out earlier. Items saved with descriptive text attached come back without that text, or carrying text that does not match what was entered.

Typing in an entry with a start time, saving, and bringing it back up yields a date one month earlier than the one typed in, with entries dated to January coming back with a month number of zero; the files written out for exchange with other programs carry the same shifted month. An entry that covers a whole date is given a start instant that is not the beginning of that date, so it turns up in the wrong place among that date's output and is written out with a time that does not belong to it.
